name: Tess
bio: 22, economics student, plays Factorio, Cookie Clicker and Hearts of Iron. Opens a spreadsheet for every game. Wants to find the dominant strategy within 20 minutes.
goals: Work out the economy: what makes gold and cash grow fastest
Find the bottleneck and the best investment
Push the clock to the fastest speed and break the curve
readingStyle: Reads numbers carefully, ignores flavour text. Compares stats across the hiring catalogue.
skills: Expert. Uses Settings to speed up time. Will invest gold, hire repeatedly, try open a new restaurant.
researchQuestions: Is there enough information on screen to make economic decisions (rates, costs, payback)?
Is there a clear progression goal and a sense of growth?
Where does the economy stall or feel pointless?
Are there exploits or dominant strategies?
quirks: Hires the most expensive things first
